feature: ADR governance: decision-cards + hybrid retrieval injected at SOP GROUND
description: Make ADRs binding at decision time: structured decision-cards, hybrid retrieval (deterministic Applies-To backbone + semantic embeddings + supersession filter), injected into the SOP GROUND pack before any code_patch/adr_draft, plus a conflict gate and doctor-as-gate. Implements ADR-2605301228. P0 (the deterministic `hex adr governing` backbone) already shipped in commit c4a06f35.
notes: Root cause this addresses: detectors run out-of-loop and aren't enforced as gates (same shape as the inference coupling). P0 done: hex adr governing + Applies-To/Superseded-By fields + date-only ID parser hardening (commits c4a06f35, 1041cc19).

phases.name: Deterministic Applies-To gate (DONE)
phases.description: hex adr governing <path> over Accepted, non-superseded ADRs; Applies-To + Superseded-By fields; supersession filter. Shipped c4a06f35.

tasks.name: hex adr governing command + Applies-To/supersession parsing

phases.name: Decision-card schema + backfill
phases.description: Formalize the decision-card fields (decision, constraints, applies_to, supersedes/superseded_by); extend hex adr schema + doctor to validate; backfill the hot-area Accepted ADRs.

gate.command: cargo check -p hex-cli && hex adr doctor --strict

tasks.name: Backfill Applies-To/constraints on hot-area Accepted ADRs

phases.name: Conflict gate at code_patch / adr_draft
phases.description: Before applying a code_patch (or emitting adr_draft) on a path, run the deterministic governing-ADR lookup; require compliance or an explicit supersedes link.

tasks.name: Wire governing-ADR conflict gate into code_patch/adr_draft tool path

phases.name: Hybrid retrieval (semantic recall booster)
phases.description: Embed decision-cards via the inference port (embeddings model) -> AgentDB/STDB; replace the keyword-only hex adr search with hybrid (deterministic Applies-To + top-K semantic), filtered by supersession.

tasks.name: Embed decision-cards into AgentDB/STDB; re-embed on create/status-change
Hybrid hex adr search (deterministic + semantic + supersession filter)

phases.name: GROUND-phase injection + doctor-as-gate
phases.description: Inject 'Governing ADRs (binding): [cards]' into the SOP ground pack + auto_repair dispatch. Wire hex adr doctor --strict into hex ci / pre-commit / adr_draft; canonical ID generation on creation; Tier-A sched auto-heal.

gate.command: hex adr doctor --strict && cargo test -p hex-nexus
